headline: Hindalco terminates AluChem deal after year-long CFIUS review delays
detail: Parties cited extended closing delays beyond their control; press links these to a CFIUS review repeatedly paused by US government shutdowns. No CFIUS decision reported. Deal value 125 million dollars, announced June 2025.

headline: Germany intends to prohibit Cosco's 80 per cent stake in Zippel
target: Konrad Zippel Spedition (80 per cent stake)
authority: Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy (BMWE)
detail: Investment review under AWG/AWV; government reportedly intends to prohibit. Reported grounds: strategic dependencies usable as leverage in political upheaval; software systems and sensitive data; Bundeswehr/NATO logistics; transport infrastructure availability in crisis. Antitrust clearance February 2026. No formal decision as of 2 Oct 2026.

headline: Italy imposes golden power prescriptions on Pirelli–ABET HTS defence agreement
acquirer: Pirelli & C. S.p.A. (co-development agreement with ABET High Tech Solutions S.r.l.)
target: ABET High Tech Solutions S.r.l. / Pirelli defence activities (cooperation agreement, not an acquisition)
authority: Presidency of the Council of Ministers (golden power, DL 21/2012)
detail: Techno-organisational prescriptions to safeguard industrial property, know-how, products and strategic data and ensure continuity and standards of R&D; detailed terms not disclosed.

headline: CFIUS clears BitFuFu's stake in Oklahoma bitcoin miner under national security agreement
authority: CFIUS (DHS and Treasury as monitoring agencies)
detail: National security agreement: use restricted to specified crypto mining operations; limits on certain advanced computing hardware; government oversight of improvements and equipment changes; ongoing compliance framework.

headline: Canada orders formal ICA review of China Union Holdings' Arizaro lithium deal
target: Argentum Lithium S.A. (Arizaro lithium project; linked to Lithium Chile Inc.)
authority: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada (Investment Canada Act)
detail: Formal review ordered under section 25 of the Investment Canada Act; grounds not disclosed; acquirer reviewing the order.
